limits.en: Core desktop/mobile app is free with no feature restrictions; commercial use is allowed without payment

keyLimits.en: No sign-up required, full local Markdown app, no feature limits
End-to-end encrypted cross-device sync, version history, shared vault collaboration
Per site; publish notes as a website, customizable themes, graph and full-text search

addOns.en: Catalyst one-time support license: $25 (beta access, community badge)
Commercial license: $50/user/year, optional (commercial use of the free app does not require it)

cautions.en: Obsidian's core note-taking app is free even for commercial use; Sync and Publish are the only recurring paid services and are optional.

capabilities.en: Local-first Markdown notes with bidirectional linking and graph visualization
Canvas for freeform brainstorming and diagramming
Daily notes, task tracking, and one year of local version history
Extensible via an open plugin API and thousands of community plugins and themes

limitations.en: No built-in real-time multi-user collaboration; shared vaults rely on the paid Sync service
Cross-device syncing is not included in the free core app and requires the paid Sync add-on (or manual/third-party sync)

reason.en: Popular all-in-one workspace covering notes and organization
Open-source local-first outliner with similar linking model
Networked-thought note tool with bidirectional linking
Notes app with similar knowledge-graph approach
Visual note-taking and knowledge organization alternative
